g.text: Pairs of design axes act close to independently

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: Each cell is the mean over the sampled designs in it, marginalising over the five axes not shown.

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: Left three: the axes with the largest single-axis swing. Right: a pair chosen by hand.
